$comment: Procedural environment (docs/PROCEDURAL_ENVIRONMENT.md, docs/PROCEDURAL_ENVIRONMENT_AUDIT.md §9–10). Species are one file per family, content/environment/<family>.json. tools/content/environment.mjs (pnpm content:environment; content:check runs it with --check) builds each species' variants from their seeds into packages/client/public/env/<family>.<species>.<variant>.glb (levels of detail and a crossed-card stand-in for the distance), the shared pictures (bark, rock, leaves) into packages/client/public/env/, content/environment.lock.json, packages/shared/src/content/environment.generated.ts (gameplay only: sizes, collision shapes, surfaces, nav, concealment) and packages/client/src/content/environment.generated.ts (files and levels of detail). generatorVersion: bump it when the generator's code changes its output. budgets: per category, triangles per level of detail (level 0 first) and bytes per file.
